review.notes: Full review. Sampled targets 5.17a, 6.1 and 6.2: the README gives no locators. Bost-Gillet-Soule 1994 and Philippon 1991 could not be read legally (AMS host unclassified; Springer paywall); Gillet-Soule 1990 read on Numdam. Every Check of 5.17a, 6.1 and 6.2 recomputed (closed forms, quadrature, Monte Carlo); all agree. Suggested.lean elaborates with no message and declares nothing, justified because no carrier exists at the pins. Dependency check: 0 problems. Automatic checks all passed; none set aside. One P2: the height of P(J^dual) is owned both here (6.2 (a7)) and by HeightsForLogSingularMetrics 4.3b (a), which does not cite this roadmap.
